tools.name: sessions
tools.title: List the sessions
tools.description: List the app's sessions and what each is doing. Read-only.

state.description: Keep only the sessions in this state.

tools.name: session
tools.title: Read one session
tools.description: Read one session and the question or plan it waits on, if any. Read-only.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

tools.name: messages
tools.title: Read a session's messages
tools.description: Read the last messages of a session. Read-only.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

tools.name: open
tools.title: Show a session
tools.description: Bring a session to the front of the app's window. Read-only.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

tools.name: send
tools.title: Message a session
tools.description: Send a message to a session, which its owner may read. A person says yes first.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

delivery.description: Now, or behind what the session is doing.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Send a message to a session, as a peer message.

tools.name: create
tools.title: Create a session
tools.description: Create a session in the app, which its owner will see. A person says yes first.

project.description: The project, by id or name.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Make a session on a project (or a chat), optionally with a first prompt.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.title: Answer a session's question
tools.description: Answer a question a session asked, as the session's owner would. A person says yes first.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Answer a question the watch heard the session ask.

tools.name: plan
tools.title: Approve or reject a plan
tools.description: Approve or reject a plan a session offered. A person says yes first.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

approved.description: True to approve, false to reject.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Approve or reject a plan the watch heard a session offer.

tools.name: archive
tools.title: Archive a session
tools.description: Archive a session. A person says yes first.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

ownerAsked.description: The owner asked for this archive, so a session this agent did not create may go.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: Archive a session this agent created, or one the owner asked to archive.

tools.name: automation
tools.title: Read or change a session's automation
tools.description: Read, replace or clear a session's automation, which sends messages on a schedule. A person says yes first.

id.description: The session: its whole id, or the first 8 or more characters of it.

_meta.ouro.bot/confirm: A session's automations (with no fields), replace one, or clear it.

tools.name: run_workflow
tools.title: Run a workflow
tools.description: Run one of the app's workflows now. A person says yes first.
